                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ମୁଖ୍ୟ ପଏଣ୍ଟ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \"exquisite\" ଶବ୍ଦଟି ଅତ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସୁନ୍ଦର, ସୂକ୍ଷ୍ମ କିମ୍ବା ଭଲ ଭାବରେ ତିଆରି ହୋଇଥିବା ଜିନିଷକୁ ବୁଝାଏ। (ଅତି ସୁନ୍ଦର, ଉତ୍କୃଷ୍ଟ)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ଉଦାହରଣ: କଳାକାର ଏକ exquisite ମୂର୍ତ୍ତି ତିଆରି କଲେ ଯାହା ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ମନ୍ତ୍ରମୁଗ୍ଧ କରିଦେଲା।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \"Beautiful\" ଅର୍ଥ ହେଉଛି ଯାହା ଇନ୍ଦ୍ରିୟ କିମ୍ବା ମନକୁ ଆନନ୍ଦ ଦେଉଥାଏ, ଏହା ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ଶାରୀରିକ କିମ୍ବା ସୌନ୍ଦର୍ଯ୍ୟମୟ ଆକର୍ଷଣକୁ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରିବା ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ହୁଏ। (ସୁନ୍ଦର)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ଉଦାହରଣ: ବଗିଚାଟି ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ରଙ୍ଗର ସୁନ୍ଦର ଫୁଲରେ ଭରି ରହିଥିଲା।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ତେଣୁ, \"exquisite\" ହେଉଛି \"beautiful\" ର ସମାର୍ଥକ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Average (औसत): ସାଧାରଣ କିମ୍ବା ଅସାଧାରଣ ନୁହେଁ।\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ଉଦାହରଣ: ପରୀକ୍ଷାରେ ତାଙ୍କର ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ average ଥିଲା, ଉତ୍କୃଷ୍ଟ କିମ୍ବା ଖରାପ ନୁହେଁ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Plain (साधारण): ସରଳ କିମ୍ବା ସାଧାରଣ, ସାଜସଜ୍ଜା କିମ୍ବା ସୌନ୍ଦର୍ଯ୍ୟର ଅଭାବ।\n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ଉଦାହରଣ: ସେ fancy ପୋଷାକ ଅପେକ୍ଷା plain ପୋଷାକ ପସନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତି।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The sentence \"He go to school every day\" contains an error in the use of the simple present tense.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • In the simple present tense, when the subject is singular (e.g., \"He,\" \"She,\" \"It\"), the verb must take the form of verb + s/es.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Hence, the phrase "ivory tower" is the most suitable replacement for the underlined segment in the sentence.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • We need a verb (or gerund) that describes an action related to air pollution that would be considered "in the public interest."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • "Reducing" (gerund) means making something smaller or less in amount or degree. Reducing air pollution is a widely recognized public interest goal, aligning perfectly with "protecting biodiversity."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • "Abdicating" means failing to fulfill a duty, which is the opposite of what would be in the public interest.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • "Increasing" air pollution would be detrimental to public interest.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • "Manipulating" air pollution implies control, but not necessarily for public benefit, and often has negative connotations.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 3'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Complete Passage: How environmental problems 1. affect different groups is a function of social inequality. Social status and power determine the 2. extent to which people can insulate themselves from environmental crises or overcome them. In some cases, their ‘solutions’ may actually worsen environmental disparities. In Kutch, Gujarat, where water is scarce, richer farmers have 3. invested in deep bore tubewells to tap groundwater to irrigate their fields and grow cash crops. When the rains fail, the earthen wells of the poorer villagers run dry and they do not even have water to drink. At such times, the moist green fields of the rich farmers seem to mock them. Certain environmental concerns sometimes appear to be universal concerns, not particular to 4. specific social groups. For instance, 5. reducing air pollution or protecting biodiversity seems to be in the public interest. A sociological analysis shows, however, that how public priorities are set and how they are pursued may not be universally beneficial.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Abdicating: To renounce or fail to undertake a responsibility. This is the opposite of what would be in the public interest.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Increasing: To make greater in size, amount, or degree. Increasing air pollution is harmful, not beneficial.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Manipulating: To control or influence skillfully, or unfairly. While one might manipulate policy, manipulating pollution itself is not the desired action for public benefit.
